header.title: TreeView
header.description: Shows hierarchical data, such as folders or org charts, in branches that open and close. Supports single or multiple selection, cascading checkboxes, and keyboard navigation that follows the ARIA `tree` pattern.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Adjust the props and try the tree with the mouse and keyboard. Each branch's arrow opens it; clicking the row selects it.

base.title: Basic usage
base.description: Pass the nodes in `items`; nodes with `children` are branches. `defaultOpen` opens a branch on mount and `defaultSelectedIds` sets the initial selection. Use `findTreePath` to build the path of the node that `onSelect` receives.

lines.title: Guide lines
lines.description: `showLines` draws a vertical line for each level, which helps follow deep trees. `defaultExpandAll` opens every branch on first mount.

multiple.title: Multiple selection
multiple.description: With `selectionMode="multiple"`, a click replaces the selection and Ctrl or Cmd + click adds or removes nodes. On the keyboard, Ctrl or Cmd + Enter does the same. There is no Shift range selection.

checkable.title: Checkboxes
checkable.description: `checkable` adds a checkbox to each node; toggle it with a click or Space. With `cascadeCheck` (on by default), checking a branch checks its children, and a branch with some children checked becomes mixed. `checkedIds` also includes fully checked branches. Checking a node also selects it.

expand.title: Controlled expansion
expand.description: `expandedIds` and `onExpandedChange` control which branches are open. `collectBranchIds` returns the ids of every branch, which is handy for an expand-all button.

filter.title: Filtering
filter.description: The component does not filter: filter `items` yourself and keep the ancestors of each match. In this example, changing the `key` remounts the tree so the result's branches open and focus resets.

icons.title: Icons and trailing content
icons.description: `icon` replaces the default folder and file icons. `end` adds content at the end of the row, like a count. The `end` text is added to the accessible name (“Starred 2”), so here each node with a count has a clearer `ariaLabel`. Don't put interactive elements in `end`: they would end up inside a `treeitem`.

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: `disabled` on a node prevents selecting, checking, and opening it, and the keyboard skips it. `isDisabled` disables the whole tree.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: `size` adjusts indentation, row height, type, and icons: `sm`, `md` (default), or `lg`.

richLabel.title: Custom labels
richLabel.description: `label` accepts any React node. When it isn't plain text, the default accessible name is “Item”: pass `ariaLabel` with a clear name. It also helps drop decorative symbols, like the `#` in channel names. A non-text label doesn't get the tree's type styles: wrap the text in `Typography` with `variant="caption"` (or `bodySm` at `lg`).

header.title: TreeView API
header.description: API reference for the React TreeView: props, node shape, helpers, CSS classes, variables, tokens, and exported types.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: For examples and usage details, visit the component's demo page.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import it from the main entry or from its subpath. The helpers are exported from both.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: TreeView accepts <ul> attributes, except children, onChange, onSelect, and defaultValue. They go to the root list. Your own onKeyDown runs before the component's; if you call preventDefault, the component skips that key.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.roles: Uses role="tree", treeitem, and group, with aria-level, aria-setsize, aria-posinset, aria-expanded, and aria-selected. The tree's name is listLabel, which defaults to “Tree”: always pass it.
a11y.keyboard: The tree is a single Tab stop. Up and Down arrows move through visible nodes; Right opens a branch or moves to its first child; Left closes it or moves to the parent; Home and End go to the first and last node. Enter selects, and Space selects, or checks when checkable.
a11y.multiple: With selectionMode="multiple" it adds aria-multiselectable. Ctrl or Cmd + Enter adds or removes the node from the selection.
a11y.checkbox: With checkable, each node exposes aria-checked, with mixed for partially checked branches. The visible checkbox and arrow are out of the Tab order and hidden from screen readers: the state is announced on the treeitem itself.
a11y.names: When label is text, the node's accessible name is that text. Otherwise the default name is “Item”: pass ariaLabel.
a11y.richLabel: Also use ariaLabel to drop decorative symbols from the name, or to add information the visual label only shows as an icon or color.
a11y.end: With a text label, the end text is added to the node's name: a “Starred” branch with a count is announced as “Starred 2”. Pass ariaLabel for a clear name, like “Starred, 2 items”. Don't put buttons or links in end: they would be nested in the treeitem and can't be reached with Tab.
a11y.focusCollapse: If you close with the mouse a branch that contains the focused node, focus moves to the body and the tree is left with no focusable node: Tab skips it until you click a row. The same happens if you remove the focused node from items. If you filter or replace the data, remount the tree with a new key.
a11y.disabled: Nodes with disabled get aria-disabled and the keyboard skips them. With isDisabled, the tree still receives Tab focus but ignores keyboard and mouse input.
a11y.missing: There is no typeahead, no * key to open sibling branches, and no Shift range selection. For large trees, add a search field like in the filtering example.

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: Classes you can use to override styles. To win on specificity, combine them with your own class, like `.gem-tree.custom-tree`.

rules.size: Size: `--sm`, `--md`, or `--lg`. Sets indentation, row height, and icons.
rules.bordered: Applied with `bordered`: adds a border and padding.
rules.lines: Applied with `showLines`: draws each group's guide line.
rules.disabled: Applied with `isDisabled`: lowers opacity and turns off pointer events.
rules.row: Visible row of the node. Receives `classNames.row` and the per-level indentation.
rules.spacer: Empty space instead of the arrow, to align leaves.
rules.label: Label. Truncates with an ellipsis. Receives `classNames.label`.
rules.end: Trailing content of the row. Receives `classNames.end`.
rules.group: `<ul role="group">` with an open branch's children. Receives `classNames.group`.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: Defined on `.gem-tree`; override them from your class or with Tailwind utilities.

items.--gem-tree-muted: Color of icons, arrows, and trailing content.
items.--gem-tree-gap: Space between arrow, checkbox, icon, and label.
items.--gem-tree-toggle: Arrow button size. Also positions the guide lines.
items.--gem-tree-level: Node level, set inline on each row and group. Don't override it: it's used to compute indentation.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: System tokens behind the default values. Changing them changes every tree.

items.--gem-color-primary-{500|600|700}: Selection (500 mixed at 12%, text 700), branch icon (600), and fallback focus ring.
items.--gem-radius-{sm|md|lg}: Tree radius with `bordered`, and row radius (`sm`).
items.--gem-palette-neutral-{50|300|600|700}: Text, icons, lines, and border in dark mode.

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers. `FlatTreeNode` and `TreeCheckState` are exported too.

selection.title: Selection
selection.description: Which nodes are selected when activated.

check.title: Checkboxes
check.description: Node checking, with or without cascade.

helpers.title: Helpers
helpers.description: Exported functions for working with the same data the tree receives.

items.items: Top-level nodes. Every `id` must be unique across the whole tree.
items.listLabel: Accessible name of the tree. Defaults to “Tree”.
items.showLines: Draws guide lines along nested groups.
items.hideIcons: Hides the default folder and file icons. Custom `icon` values still render.
items.bordered: Adds a border and padding around the tree.
items.selectionMode: `single` selects one node, `multiple` lets you add with Ctrl or Cmd, and `none` turns selection off.
items.defaultSelectedIds: Initial selection, in uncontrolled mode. The first one also gets initial focus.
items.onSelect: Called when the selection changes, with the new ids and the activated node.
items.expandedIds: Open branch ids, in controlled mode.
items.defaultExpandedIds: Branches open on mount. When passed, `defaultOpen` and `defaultExpandAll` are ignored.
items.defaultExpandAll: Opens every branch on first mount.
items.onExpandedChange: Called when a branch opens or closes, with the open ids and the branch that changed.
items.checkable: Shows a checkbox on every node.
items.defaultCheckedIds: Ids checked on mount, in uncontrolled mode.
items.cascadeCheck: Checking a branch checks its children, and the branch state follows its children. Disabled children don't change.
items.onCheckedChange: Called when a node is checked or unchecked, with the checked ids, the node, and its new state.
items.className: Extra classes for the root list.

node.id: Stable key. Used for selection, expansion, checkboxes, and DOM ids.
node.label: Visible content. When it isn't text, pass `ariaLabel`.
node.icon: Leading icon. Defaults to a folder for branches and a file for leaves.
node.children: Child nodes. With at least one, the node is a branch.
node.defaultOpen: Opens the branch on first mount, in uncontrolled mode.
node.disabled: Prevents selecting, checking, and opening the node, and the keyboard skips it.
node.end: Content at the end of the row, like a count. Avoid interactive elements.
node.ariaLabel: Accessible name of the node. Required when `label` isn't text.

helpers.findTreePath: Returns the nodes from the root to the id, or `null`.
helpers.collectBranchIds: Ids of every branch. Handy for expanding everything.
helpers.collectDescendantIds: Ids of all descendants of a node.
helpers.collectDefaultExpandedIds: Branches with `defaultOpen`, or all of them when `expandAll` is `true`.
helpers.flattenVisibleTree: Flat list of visible nodes, with level, parent, and position.
helpers.hasTreeNode: `true` when the value renders (not `null`, `false`, or empty text).
helpers.applyTreeCheck: Computes the checked ids after toggling a node, with or without cascade.
helpers.nodeName: Accessible name the component sets as `aria-label`: `ariaLabel`, nothing when the label is text, or “Item”.
